flows:
Navigate to https://www.ventusky.com/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
First assert the Precipitation control in the Forecast panel is in the sequential keyboard focus order.
Using Tab and Enter, switch from the default Temperature map to Precipitation.
Verify the map shows Precipitation and the 3 hours accumulation option.

summary:

Update the keyboard-navigation routine to inspect the currently focused visible control after each Tab, stop when Precipitation receives focus, press Enter once, and immediately verify the precipitation map and 3-hour accumulation option.
